subject.title: fix: prevent session exports from writing outside workspace

question: Should full `/export-session` output be permanently restricted to command owners, in addition to workspace confinement?
rationale: Workspace confinement is clearly required, but revoking configured authorized non-owner access is a compatibility and security-policy choice that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Owner-only exports
options.body: Land owner gating and workspace confinement on the release branch and current main.

options.title: Authorized exports, safe paths
options.body: Preserve authorized non-owner access while enforcing canonical workspace confinement.

options.title: Pause session exports
options.body: Hold the command until its permanent privileged-access contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Owner-only exports
recommendation.body: Land owner gating and workspace confinement on the release branch and current main.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original feature and has the strongest combined history across its command-policy and fs-safe boundaries.
